title: IGNTU–tAcT Science Webinar
teaser: Science webinar jointly organised by Indira Gandhi National Tribal University, Amarkantak, and tAcT. Speakers: Prof. N. Sathyamurthy on "The Chemical Bond" and Prof. S. Ananthakrishnan on radio astronomy and India's radio telescopes.
homepageMatter: On 28 September 2020, Indira Gandhi National Tribal University (IGNTU), Amarkantak, Madhya Pradesh, and tAcT jointly organised an online science webinar. Prof. N. Sathyamurthy spoke on the chemical bond, and Prof. S. Ananthakrishnan on radio astronomy, covering India's giant radio telescopes built under Prof. Govind Swarup.
